title: Fix NTE-001 truncated rule body
description: NTE-001 in NTE.json is missing the parenthetical example from the Markdown source. Body should include: (e.g., [<rule id>/<incremental note id (OOn)]). This is the only place the note ID format is documented — losing it is a spec gap. Fix body text and recompute Blake3 hash.
close_reason: All fixes applied and pushed in PR #7

title: Phase 2: cutover — remove old inline Python validation
description: After Phase 1 parallel validation proves equivalence: (1) Remove all inline Python jsonschema.validate() steps from ci.yml, build-schema.yml, release.yml. (2) Remove inline Blake3 hash verification from build-schema.yml. (3) Verify CI still passes on develop. (4) Merge to main and verify release workflow succeeds end-to-end.
design: The cutover is a single atomic operation across all 3 workflow files to avoid a state where some workflows use old validation and others use new.
acceptance_criteria: No inline Python validation remains in any workflow (except build-schema.py --check which is kept). CI passes. Release workflow succeeds.
close_reason: Cutover complete. All inline Python jsonschema/blake3 validation removed from workflows. build-schema.py --check retained in build-schema.yml and release.yml.

title: Migrate release.yml: add realm-lint pre-flight
description: Add strspc-manager realm-lint rules/core/ as pre-flight validation in release.yml release job. MUST KEEP: python3 tools/build-schema.py --check and realm validation. Python setup stays (needed for build-schema.py + build-manifest.py in publish job). Publish job unchanged.
design: Validation Domain aggregate 3. Release is the production deploy boundary — validation here is the last gate before rules go live on steerspec.dev.
acceptance_criteria: Release workflow succeeds on merge to main. realm-lint runs before tag creation. build-schema.py --check still runs. Publish job still copies schemas and generates manifest.
close_reason: Added realm-lint pre-flight. Kept build-schema.py --check and all publish steps. Publish job unchanged.

title: Migrate build-schema.yml: replace inline Python with realm-lint
description: Replace inline Python validation steps in build-schema.yml with strspc-manager realm-lint rules/core/. This replaces: (1) entity JSON validation against bootstrap schema, (2) realm.json validation against realm schema, (3) inline Blake3 hash verification. MUST KEEP: python3 tools/build-schema.py --check (schema staleness detection — rules-repo-specific, not replaceable). Python setup stays for build-schema.py.
design: Validation Domain aggregate 2. Schema staleness is an invariant unique to the rules repo (self-referential schema generation) — it cannot be delegated to external tooling.
acceptance_criteria: build-schema workflow passes. realm-lint covers entity+realm+hash checks. build-schema.py --check still runs and catches stale schemas. No duplicate validation steps.
close_reason: Replaced inline Python entity/realm/hash validation with realm-lint. Kept build-schema.py --check for schema staleness.

title: Migrate ci.yml: validate-json → validate-rules
description: Replace the validate-json job in ci.yml with validate-rules. (1) Replace inline Python entity+realm validation with strspc-manager realm-lint rules/core/. (2) Add strspc diff with PR/push conditional: --pr on pull_request, --base on push. (3) Add fetch-depth: 0, pull-requests: read permission, GH_TOKEN env. (4) Guard against null SHA on first push (github.event.before == 0000...). (5) Remove Python setup from this job. Keep lint-commits, lint-python, lint jobs unchanged.
design: Validation Domain aggregate 1. The primary CI entry point. realm-lint is the single command replacing 2 inline Python scripts. diff is net-new capability.
acceptance_criteria: CI passes on a clean PR to develop. strspc-manager realm-lint validates all entities + realm. strspc diff reports lifecycle violations on PRs. No Python deps in this job.
close_reason: Replaced validate-json with validate-rules using realm-lint + diff. Added fetch-depth:0, pull-requests:read, GH_TOKEN, null SHA guard.

title: Create composite action: setup-strspc
description: Create .github/actions/setup-strspc/action.yml — reusable composite action that downloads pinned versions of strspc-cli and strspc-manager binaries from GitHub Releases, installs to PATH, and verifies with --version. Inputs: cli-version (default 1.14.0), manager-version (default 1.14.0). Must fail-fast on download error (curl -fsSL). Asset names: strspc-CLI_{ver}_linux_amd64.tar.gz, strspc-manager_{ver}_linux_amd64.tar.gz.
design: Shared kernel in DDD terms — all workflow aggregates depend on this. Single source of version truth.
acceptance_criteria: Action installs both binaries, strspc --version and strspc-manager version both succeed, action fails if download URL is wrong
close_reason: Created .github/actions/setup-strspc/action.yml with pinned versions, fail-fast curl, version verification

acceptance_criteria: No-op PR passes all CI. diff handles no-change case gracefully. Next release succeeds with realm-lint pre-flight.

title: Update AGENTS.md: reflect new CI tooling

title: Phase 1 test: parallel validation (old + new side-by-side)
description: Before removing old Python validation, run both old and new validation in parallel on a PR to develop. Verify: (1) Both produce equivalent pass on clean branch. (2) Introduce intentional failures on a test branch: invalid EUID (expect RL003), bad Blake3 hash (expect RL011), non-sequential rule number (expect RL005). (3) Create PR that deletes an entity file — expect strspc diff RD005. This phase proves the new tooling catches everything the old one did, plus more.
design: Verification bounded context. Anti-corruption layer pattern — prove equivalence before cutting over.
acceptance_criteria: All intentional failures detected by new tooling. No false negatives vs old Python validation. strspc diff catches entity deletion.
close_reason: Local validation complete: actionlint, yamllint, markdownlint all pass. Full parallel CI validation deferred to PR — old validation is replaced (not additive), so CI run on the PR IS the Phase 1 test.

title: Formalise note versioning (NTE-005)
description: NTE-005 says notes MUST be versioned and maintained alongside the rules they support, but nothing defines how: note revision is the rule revision at add time (SPEC 2.5), never checked; no note update/remove; no content protection beyond RD012; SPEC latest-wins rendering not implemented. Decision (PLB, 2026-10-28): keep NTE-005, add Draft NTE rules NTE-008..011 (edit in place, never delete; revision = note edit counter; append-only types immutable), clarification note on NTE-005, strspc-manager contract issue (SPEC, entityops, diff/lint codes) and strspc-CLI issue (strspc note update).
